title: What Do Americans Say at the New Year? (2/2)
titleZh: 美國人在新年時會說什麼？(2/2)
summaryZh: 節目結尾感謝聽眾一年來的支持，祝福新年學習順利，並邀請大家來信提問。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: The VOA Learning English team would like to thank readers like you, Maria, for making 2021 a great year for us.
sentences.zh: VOA Learning English 團隊要感謝像 Maria 你這樣的讀者，讓 2021 年對我們來說是很棒的一年。

sentences.text: We wish you all a wonderful year of learning together in 2022. What question do you have about American English?
sentences.zh: 祝大家在 2022 年一起度過美好的學習時光。你對美式英文有什麼問題嗎？

sentences.text: Send us an email at learningenglish@voanews.
com And that's Ask a Teacher.
